confusions: The Hunter's Sortie quest named three wolf dens (Charcoal Ring, Twin Stones, Wolf Scrape) but Charcoal Ring was never found despite extensive exploration around the Vale wood; the quest completed anyway after peacefully resolving the other two, leaving it unclear whether the third existed or was optional.

Multi-step 'the way there' directions for hold-quest locations (e.g. 'one south, then one east, then out, then six west') required frequent backtracking and repeated free 'get your bearings' checks to navigate sprawling wilderness maps (Thornwold's wood, the Iron Downs, Wardmoor's moor); room names rarely hinted at the target, so wrong turns were common.
suggestions: Add a 'head toward <quest location>' travel shortcut once its rough direction is known, instead of requiring manual step-by-step wilderness navigation.
Clarify in the quest text whether all named sub-locations (e.g. all three wolf dens) must be visited, or whether partial resolution is sufficient.
Surface theft warnings more persistently (e.g. always inline on the take-item action label) since they're easy to miss after several turns spent in the same room.
